name: stale_aggregate
description: In `app.put('/api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber')`, updating a lineitem's `l_extendedprice`, `l_discount`, or `l_tax` does not recalculate and update `orders.o_totalprice`. The `o_totalprice` aggregate stored in the parent `orders` table becomes stale when line items are modified, and `app.get('/api/orders/:o_orderkey')` serves this outdated value.
